error_reason: This is the decisive error. The Planner accepted an incomplete search result showing only a browser upgrade prompt as 'search results,' inferred incorrect facts (that Ric Burns was the director), and prematurely issued a 'final_answer' instruction (instructing WebSurfer to provide a final answer or switching context) without verifying the actual content of the search page or correcting the initial search query. This error propagated by forcing the agent to chase a wrong lead (Ric Burns vs Ken Burns) based on hallucinated or misinterpreted 'final answer' constraints derived from empty data.
